india_alignment.label: Genuinely Non-Aligned (moderate Western lean)
india_alignment.interpretation: India buys Russian oil, sits in BRICS and SCO, but also joins QUAD and buys Western weapons. Currently the most non-aligned major country. Under increasing pressure to choose.
india_alignment.punjab_impact: Non-alignment keeps multiple diaspora corridors open. A forced choice would close either Five Eyes (Canada/UK/Australia) or Russia/Gulf channels.

UN_SC.name: UN Security Council
UN_SC.note: India has no veto. Permanent members control any binding resolution on South Asia.
UN_SC.punjab_relevance: Any India-Pakistan conflict requires UNSC resolution. China (Pakistan ally) and USA (India partner) both have veto. Punjab is the battlefield.

BRICS.name: BRICS+
BRICS.note: India-China border dispute while in same bloc creates structural tension.
BRICS.punjab_relevance: De-dollarisation push affects remittance corridors. Russia-India oil trade boosts economy but angers West — affects diaspora visa access.

SCO.name: Shanghai Cooperation Organisation
SCO.note: India and Pakistan both members since 2017. China leads de facto.
SCO.punjab_relevance: SCO frames India-Pakistan dialogue through Chinese-led structure. Sikh pilgrimage to Pakistan (Nankana Sahib, Panja Sahib) dependent on India-Pakistan SCO cooperation.

G20.name: G20
G20.note: India held G20 presidency 2023. Food security and fertiliser supply chain are G20 agenda items.
G20.punjab_relevance: G20 food security resolutions directly affect global wheat/fertiliser prices that Punjab agriculture depends on.

G7.name: G7
G7.note: G7 controls global financial sanctions (SWIFT), technology export controls, and sets norms India must navigate.
G7.punjab_relevance: G7 sanctions on Russia restrict India trade. Canada-India tension directly affects Punjab NRI remittances and immigration.

QUAD.name: Quadrilateral Security Dialogue
QUAD.note: Anti-China in practice. India participates but hedges — simultaneously in SCO and BRICS with China.
QUAD.punjab_relevance: If QUAD becomes formal alliance, India must take a side. China-India tension escalates. Punjab border posture affected.

CPEC.name: China-Pakistan Economic Corridor
CPEC.note: Passes through Pakistan-administered Kashmir — India rejects as sovereignty violation.
CPEC.punjab_relevance: CPEC completion changes Central Asian trade routes. Wagah crossing importance shifts. Long-term Punjab trade economics affected.

INSTC.name: International North-South Transport Corridor
INSTC.note: India alternative to CPEC. Bypasses Pakistan entirely.
INSTC.punjab_relevance: INSTC success reduces India dependence on Pakistan transit. Punjab agricultural exports could reach Central Asia via this corridor.

next_yalta_scenarios.title: Indus Waters Treaty Collapses
next_yalta_scenarios.trigger: India suspends Indus Waters Treaty post-attack. Pakistan counter-escalates.
next_yalta_scenarios.punjab_impact: CRITICAL — Punjab rivers are Indus tributaries. Ravi, Beas, Sutlej. Agricultural water access existential.
next_yalta_scenarios.signal_to_watch: India-Pakistan IWT meetings, World Bank arbitration filings

next_yalta_scenarios.title: Permanent Canada-India Diplomatic Break
next_yalta_scenarios.trigger: Further killings on Canadian soil attributed to India. Five Eyes formally sanction India.
next_yalta_scenarios.punjab_impact: HIGH — 770,000 Punjabis in Canada. Remittance corridor ($3B+/yr) at risk. Doaba region most affected.
next_yalta_scenarios.sikh_representation: Sikh MPs in Canada but no institutional Panthic representation.
next_yalta_scenarios.signal_to_watch: RCMP charges against Indian operatives, Canadian visa processing

next_yalta_scenarios.title: China-India LAC Conflict Escalates
next_yalta_scenarios.trigger: Galwan-style incident escalates. Two-front war scenario.
next_yalta_scenarios.punjab_impact: HIGH — Punjab is Indian Army primary mobilisation base. Amritsar/Jalandhar are logistics hubs.
next_yalta_scenarios.sikh_representation: Sikh soldiers disproportionate in Indian Army but zero political decision-making role.
next_yalta_scenarios.signal_to_watch: LAC troop movements, China-Pakistan coordination, US arms sales to India

next_yalta_scenarios.title: Second Global Food Crisis (Ukraine + Climate)
next_yalta_scenarios.trigger: Ukraine war continues. Climate disrupts Asian monsoon. Global wheat stocks at record low.
next_yalta_scenarios.punjab_impact: EXTREME — Punjab produces 15% India wheat, 25% rice. Export bans vs income opportunity tension.
next_yalta_scenarios.sikh_representation: Punjab farmers have no G20 voice.
next_yalta_scenarios.signal_to_watch: USDA world supply reports, India Food Corporation stock levels, monsoon forecasts

next_yalta_scenarios.title: World Splits into Two Hard Blocs
next_yalta_scenarios.trigger: USA-China tech war becomes comprehensive. SWIFT splits. India forced to choose.
next_yalta_scenarios.punjab_impact: SYSTEMIC — Sikh community split across both blocs (Five Eyes countries vs Russia/Gulf). Remittance and diaspora status split.
next_yalta_scenarios.sikh_representation: Sikh community torn. No unified Panthic position on which bloc to support.
next_yalta_scenarios.signal_to_watch: India UN votes, India CBDC system, semiconductor import sources, G20 language

yalta_pattern_history.pattern: Major powers in transition → colonial subjects ignored → violence in Punjab

yalta_pattern_history.punjab_impact: Partition 1947 decided by British withdrawal timeline. Punjab divided, 1-2 million killed.
yalta_pattern_history.pattern: Major powers redraw maps → Punjab divided → catastrophic human cost

yalta_pattern_history.punjab_impact: War fought partly on Punjab front. Simla Agreement locks Kashmir dispute permanently.
yalta_pattern_history.pattern: Superpower proxy positioning → Punjab is frontline → outcomes set by external power balance

yalta_pattern_history.punjab_impact: Sri Darbar Sahib desecrated. Thousands killed. Sikh diaspora permanently shaped.
yalta_pattern_history.pattern: India acts in Punjab → world silent → Sikh community bears consequence alone
